missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Кошка' is in the nominative as the subject of 'спит'. 'Наша' is the agreeing feminine possessive, and 'на диване' gives the location. A natural everyday scene.
Strategic focus: Animate accusative. 'Кошку' is the accusative direct object of 'ищу'. As a feminine noun the accusative has its own ending, and 'свою' agrees with it. 'Давно' adds duration.
Strategic focus: Genitive of negation. 'Кошки' is in the genitive after 'нет', which demands it. 'У соседей' shows whose household lacks a cat. A standard pattern for absence.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Кошке' is in the dative as the recipient of the action. 'Молоко' is the accusative object that was given. A clear giving pattern.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with 'с'. 'Кошкой' is in the instrumental after 'с', marking the companion in the activity. 'Девочка играет' is the subject and verb. A friendly everyday scene.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Кошке' is in the prepositional after 'о', expressing the topic of conversation. 'Много' adds frequency. A natural discussion pattern.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after numeral. After 'три' the noun takes the genitive singular form 'кошки'. 'В саду' gives the location. A useful counting pattern.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Кошки' is the nominative plural subject. 'Эти' and 'пушистые' agree in the plural, and 'очень' intensifies. A clean model for plural description.
Strategic focus: Animate accusative plural. 'Кошек' is the accusative plural, which for animate nouns matches the genitive plural. 'Своих' agrees, and 'утром' sets the time. A daily routine pattern.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'без'. 'Кошки' is in the genitive after the preposition 'без', meaning without a cat. 'В доме скучно' completes the impersonal statement. A warm domestic remark.
